An '''artillery section''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Artillery sections were generally comprised of either a single eight-man heavy or medium [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] piece, or two four-man light artillery pieces. The type of artillery deployed ranged from [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], to [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], to indirect projectile weapons.<ref name="ISB" /> At least one [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the section was armed with a [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blaster]] to provide cover fire while the artillery equipment was being set up for use.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
